_comment: Keywords that descriptions highlight, like Slay the Spire keywords. Any description run through UiGlossary colors and underlines each keyword: hovering it shows its box, clicking pins the box until a click elsewhere or Esc, and hovering a whole card or tooltip lists the boxes of every keyword it uses. Matching ignores case and needs whole words; aliases are other forms of the same keyword (Piercing, Pierces -> Pierce). text: a short definition with its numbers; it may use other keywords, which link to their own boxes. icon is an id in data/ui/icons.json (optional). Descriptions elsewhere name the keyword and its number ("Pierce 20%") and leave the explanation here.

Guard.text: Blocks that share of the next hit taken, then it is used up.

Defense.text: Takes that much off every hit (enemies fight at a region's Defense level).

Pierce.text: Ignores that share of the target's Defense.

Charge.text: Waits to fill Energy, then uses a bigger skill.

Energy.text: In a fight, a bot's power: skills spend it and it refills every tick, up to its Battery. On the map, the stockpile that map actions spend.

Battery.text: The most Energy a bot can hold in a fight.

Down.text: At 0 HP a unit is Down and out of the fight.

Wait.text: Skip ahead on the timeline, filling Energy.

Low Energy.text: Cannot afford any skill that costs Energy; it will Wait.

Reflect.text: With Guard up, sends that share of the blocked damage back at the attacker.

Weakest.text: The living enemy with the least HP. Some area skills hit it harder.

Rank.text: A skill grows with use: +1 to +5, then Mega, then Ultra. Each step adds power.

Mega.text: A skill's second tier. Mega skills gain a bonus: Pierce, Weakest, Guard on heals or Reflect.

Ultra.text: A skill's top tier, with a bigger Mega bonus.

Material.text: From held regions and won fights. Pays for Breach and Repair.

Breach.text: Pay before an attack to fight at a lower Defense level.

Retreat.text: Back out of a fight before it starts, for time and Energy. No loss counted.

Reinforce.text: Lower the Pressure on a region you hold.

Pressure.text: Builds on regions you hold. At the top an attack or uprising forces a defense.

Alert.text: How much the world has noticed you. Holding 1/3 and 2/3 of the map raises it; it never drops.

Fortify.text: Hostile regions left alone on Alert gain Defense every 9 days, up to +1.

Unnoticed.text: Alert tier 1: enemies fight 1 level lower (act 3: no change).

Local Concern.text: Alert tier 2: enemies fight at their own level, and untaken regions Fortify.

Major Crisis.text: Alert tier 3: enemies fight 1 level higher.
